description:
The proposed development comprises the erection of a single-storey rear extension, loft conversion incorporating a rear dormer roof extension, installation of 2 front rooflights, and associated internal and external alterations to the existing dwelling.

Single-Storey Rear Extension:
The proposal includes the construction of a single-storey rear extension extending approximately 6m beyond the existing rear elevation of the property. The extension will feature a flat roof design and large glazed rear openings, including bifold doors, to maximise natural daylight and improve the connection between the internal accommodation and rear garden. External materials, including facing brickwork, roof finishes, windows, and doors, will be selected to closely match the existing dwelling to ensure a cohesive and sympathetic appearance.

The extension is intended to provide improved and more functional ground floor accommodation suitable for modern family living, including enhanced open-plan living area. The scale and siting of the extension have been carefully considered to minimise any adverse impact on neighbouring amenity, including loss of light, outlook, or privacy.

Rear Dormer Extension:
The proposal further includes the conversion of the existing roof space into habitable accommodation through the construction of a rear dormer roof extension. The dormer has been designed to remain subordinate to the existing roof form, set below the existing ridge line and inset from the side boundaries to maintain a balanced and proportionate appearance. The loft conversion will provide additional residential accommodation, including 2 bedrooms, shower room, circulation space, and associated eaves storage areas.

Front Rooflights:
Two rooflights are proposed within the front roof slope facing the highway. The rooflights are modest in scale, flush fitting within the roof plane, and positioned sensitively to minimise visual impact while providing natural daylight and ventilation to the proposed loft accommodation.

Overall, the proposed development has been carefully designed to remain subordinate to the host dwelling and respectful of the surrounding residential character. The scale, materials, and detailing have been considered to ensure the proposal integrates appropriately with the existing property while providing improved and modernised living accommodation.
